items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: the tenor player was a fellow named Jack Bradley.

ctx.x: Seems like in those days things just

So we go on to Minneapolis and when we got into Minneapolis we all got our places and we organized a band there called the Ethiopian Symphonians. And it was ten pieces, we had three saxs; I was playing alto and we had a big guy named Pete Richardson playing alto and the tenor player was a fellow named Jack Bradley. And he tried to play everything like Coleman Hawkins. And we had Roy White, later they called him Snake White, had him on trumpet. And --
Who was the leader of the band?
